title: I81 (= I44a): Def 6.13's measures (holon/measures.py, one interface over PAR's holonomy defect size, NAT's naturality defect mass, FACT's F(m, c), UNDO's residue liveness distance and DISCH's discharge profile) and §10.10's lexicographic ranking (holon/rank.py: sink class, persistence, reach class, adversary cost) over the M3 laws that exist today, written to results/M3/ranking.json by holon rank and compared with §11.3's Impact column

predictions.claim: M-PAR on the three REFUTED cross-component codec laws (L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV0_Bytes_enc_sol_v0, L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1, L_par_cc_BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash_enc_sol_v2: Go's header encoders against enc_sol, the analogues of M0's L_par_hdr_ssvh): each holonomy defect is exactly the 32 byte positions 185..216 (the field Go's encoders write where enc_sol writes constants), certified: the witness's sides differ exactly there and the two layouts, under the law's premises, can differ nowhere else. No REFUTED M3 PAR law's byte-string defect holds byte 0: the analogue of M0's L_par_hdr_v2 (BUILD_PLAN I44's '1 byte position, byte 0') does not exist on today's M3, whose Go encoders write the version byte enc_sol writes at every version a law pins. The other five REFUTED PAR laws compare a verdict or an outcome: one position each, certified. Observed before the prereg (thresholds.observed_before_prereg): the three records' differences (the lower bound); the layout bound was not computed.

M-UNDO: the residue liveness distance of the L_undo_BVH analogue (L_undo_res_Rollup_revertBatch_batchBlobVersionedHashes), of L_undo_pair_Rollup_commitBatch_revertBatch and of L_undo_res_Rollup_revertBatch_batchDataStore is 1, certified minimal under the stated bound: lower 1 (an empty continuation observes nothing), upper 1 (in replay/M3/undo/report.json the model's observations of the two runs first differ at t[0], and Bend checked the counter-law over that one-step continuation). The five UNKNOWN UNDO laws get the bound [1, unbounded). Observed before the prereg: every witness's t has one step; the BVH entry's model observations were read (they differ at t[0]).

Sink classes (rules K1-K8 and the sidecar's channels) of the 24 REFUTED laws of the base: economic 2 (the FACT attribution laws), liveness 10 (the UNDO pair and BVH residue laws, the SORT realize law, the 7 DISCH laws), derivation 6 (the 3 cross-component codec laws, the header domain law, the 2 FACT kernel laws), state 2 (the PAR-init law, the SORT tag law), process 3 (the three Go-op laws over the clone pair), off-chain 1 (the batchDataStore residue law, whose first divergent step is a view), as tests_m3/_i81.py EXPECTED lists them. Against §11.3's Impact column (the instrument's IMPACT: 16 laws with an O-row analogue, O1, O4 x3, O9, O11 x2, O22 x2, O25 x2, O26, O27, O31 x3), the computed sink class matches for 14 and differs for 2: the PAR-init law (O9) and the SORT tag law (O26) are 'state' where §11.3 says finality, because a stored value's later reader is not traced. The 8 other REFUTED laws have no §11.3 row (the codec laws' sequencer-set field, the batchDataStore residue, which §11.6 D5 lists as dead, and five DISCH laws).

Reach (RE1-RE3: the most privileged principal class the witness schedule needs) of the 24 REFUTED laws, as EXPECTED lists them; against §11.3 (the instrument's REACH_WORDS: onlyActiveSubmitter is bonded, onlyChallenger challenger, onlyOwner owner), the reach matches for 5 analogue laws (PAR-init: owner; the commitBatch FACT kernel law: bonded; the SORT realize law and the two rollup_363 DISCH laws whose schedules need the challenger: challenger) and differs for the other 11: the header domain law (undecided: no concretization path), the three Go-op laws (pending I39: no node-level path), the two O11 laws, the two O25 laws and the O26 law (owner: their schedules need the owner's revertBatch, where §11.3 names the bonded class), the commitBatchWithProof kernel law (anyone, where §11.3 says bonded) and the owner's rollup_363 DISCH law (owner, where §11.3 says challenger).

Measure kinds over the base's 136 laws: value 87 (73 PROVED PAR laws at 0, 8 REFUTED PAR laws, 3 REFUTED UNDO laws, 3 FACT kernel laws), bound 9 (4 UNKNOWN PAR laws, 5 UNKNOWN UNDO laws), pending 35 (every DISCH law: pending I37, the profile needs a cost model), not_applicable 5 (2 FACT attribution laws, 3 SORT laws); no NAT law, and rules.NAT pending I29.

Persistence (PE1-PE3) and cost (CO1) of the 24 REFUTED laws, as EXPECTED lists them: code for the 7 pure-function PAR laws, dischargeable for the onlyActiveSubmitter blocking law of rollup_363 (its I32 class), undecided for the other 16 (no DISCH class decides them: I31's blocking laws are UNKNOWN, and nothing links an UNDO, FACT, SORT or PAR-init divergence to a DISCH basis element); costs from 1 call (the v0 and v1 codec laws' concretization paths) to 5 (the attribution laws), unknown for the 5 PAR laws without a path. Against §11.3, the persistence matches for the 4 pure-function analogue laws (O1, O4 x3) only.

The ranking's order is EXPECTED's: the two FACT attribution laws first (economic), then the ten liveness laws (undecided persistence before the dischargeable blocking law; challenger before owner schedules; fewer calls first), the six derivation laws, the PAR-init and SORT tag laws, the three Go-op laws, and the batchDataStore residue law last.

regressions.claim: M-FACT is I26's F(m, c), recomputed: each FACT kernel law's value equals its record's fact.measure.bits (1.0, 1.0 and 0.0); the attribution laws are not_applicable.

M-DISCH reads I32's classes: holon.profile.classification regenerates gen/M3/disch/classification.json exactly (1 dischargeable, 14 undecided entries), and every DISCH law is pending I37 with its class.
Determinism: holon rank --milestone M3 --check passes on the committed results/M3/ranking.json, and two runs write the same bytes.
Construction honesty: holon/measures.py and holon/rank.py name no law, action, register, span or target and import no test code.
Judged at each of I81's own commits: no law, record, generated or replay file changes except results/M3/ranking.json (no generator closure moves).
results/M3/ranking.json is valid against spec/schemas/ranking.schema.json, and every input it lists is the file on disk (its sha256).
Construction: for every REFUTED law, holon's channel, persistence, reach, cost and PAR lower bound are what the instrument computes by its own reading of the contract's rules.

thresholds.base: 00b12f70 (the lead after I28's build merge, PR #50: 136 M3 laws, holon-rules/1.6), with BUILD_PLAN's row I81 (13756f4a)

observed_before_prereg.read: Before writing this key the author read: every REFUTED record's status, subform, triage, filter bin, evidence levels, concretization kind, result, length and reason, and its witness keys; the full witness schedules (actions and callers) of the PAR-init, SORT realize, SORT tag, rollup_363 onlyActiveSubmitter blocking, rollup_132 owner external-none, commitState attribution and commitBatch kernel laws, and the UNDO witnesses (prefix, x, y, t); the three codec laws' differences; the concretization path of the v1 codec law; the BVH entry of replay/M3/undo/report.json (both runs' model observations); the records' replay details of the SORT laws; I32's classification and I31's basis; I26's F(m, c) of the FACT laws (holon.rules.fact.analyse was run).
observed_before_prereg.not_read: The witness schedules of the commitBatchWithProof attribution and kernel laws and of the five other external-none DISCH laws; the replay entries of the UNDO pair and batchDataStore laws (only their records' replay detail); the sorts replay report's entries; the codec layouts (beyond the first cells of two functions); the instrument's functions were never run before this commit (only compiled, and its tables checked for consistency with each other).
observed_before_prereg.I81-P1: the lower bound (the differences); not the layout bound
observed_before_prereg.I81-P2: fully (the one-step continuations and the BVH entry's divergence at t[0])
observed_before_prereg.I81-P3: mostly: the channels follow from the rules and data read, except the UNDO pair law's step (its replay entry was not read)
observed_before_prereg.I81-P4: partly: 7 of the 24 schedules were not read
observed_before_prereg.I81-P5: fully (the statuses and subforms, with the rules)
observed_before_prereg.I81-P6: partly: persistence follows from the rules and I32's classes; 7 schedules' costs were not read
observed_before_prereg.I81-P7: partly (follows from P3, P4 and P6)

thresholds.disclosure: Only I81-P1 counts toward prediction accuracy: its outcome rests on the layout bound, which nobody computed before this commit. The others are recorded, not counted: the author read most of what decides them (observed_before_prereg), and the rest follow from the preregistered policy applied to committed data. A miss in any of them is still reported as a miss.
